evals.prompt: Build the Orders page at app/pages/orders.vue for our admin app. It lists orders from useOrders() with sortable columns (order, customer, status, total), a search box, a per-column status filter, 25 rows per page, and CSV export. Status should render as a coloured badge.
evals.expected_output: The three-file table implementation: useDataTable in app/composables/useDataTable.ts, DataTable.vue and DataTablePagination.vue in app/components/shared/. The page imports only DataTable, supplies columns and rows, and renders status through the #cell-status slot. All four states (loading, error, empty, data) are present with error before empty.
assertions: The page imports only DataTable from ~/components/shared/DataTable.vue and never calls useDataTable directly
Status badges render through the #cell-status scoped slot rather than returning markup from col.cell
Loading, error, empty and data states are all handled, with the error check before the empty check
CSV export uses the composable's exportCSV and respects visible columns

evals.prompt: Our inventory page needs bulk actions. 100+ products, so give me row checkboxes with select-all, expandable rows that reveal warehouse details, and a sticky header. Support 25/50/100 per page.
evals.expected_output: A DataTable-based inventory page with selectable and expandable rows, stickyHeader enabled, pageSizeOptions covering 25/50/100, and an expansion slot rendering the warehouse detail. No hand-rolled <table> markup.
assertions: Uses the pre-built DataTable component instead of writing a raw <table> element
Passes selectable and sticky-header options through DataTable props
Selection state comes from the composable's selected set / toggleRow, not local page state
Expandable rows use the expansion slot and only render detail when expanded

evals.prompt: The /users page should list invited users. The API sometimes fails and the list is often empty in staging — make sure both cases look intentional and the user can retry.
evals.expected_output: An error state with icon, message and a working retry, rendered before the empty state; an empty state with Inbox icon and descriptive copy; loading skeletons sized to the current page size. One state visible at a time via v-if/v-else-if.
assertions: The error state renders before the empty state in the v-if chain
The error state includes a retry action wired to the composable's onRetry/refresh
The empty state uses muted styling and an inbox-style icon, not an error look
Loading skeletons render pageSize rows with animate-pulse
Only one of loading, error, empty and data is visible at a time
